name: godot-coda-engine
description: CODA: a language for clear Godot gameplay flows that generates inspectable GDScript.

scripts.demo:acceptance: npm run demo:smoke && godot --headless --path demos/d2-interruptible-behavior --script res://tests/d2_interruptible_behavior_smoke.gd && godot --headless --path demos/d3-skeleton-transition --script res://tests/d3_skeleton_transition_smoke.gd
scripts.test:godot: npm run coda -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/headless_runtime.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/reward_chain.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/reward_flow_demo_smoke.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/generated_runner.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/competition.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/editor_transactions.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/event_dock_smoke.gd && godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/integration/aibi_behavior_runtime.gd && godot --headless --path demos/d3-skeleton-transition --script res://tests/d3_skeleton_transition_smoke.gd && node scripts/test-authoring-crash-recovery.mjs
scripts.validate:generated: npm run coda -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --check-only --script res://.gseos/generated/ui_reward_apply.gd
scripts.export:pack: npm run coda -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --export-pack "CODA Runtime Pack" /tmp/coda-runtime.zip && npm run audit:pack
scripts.export:native:macos: npm run coda -- generate gseos/events/ui.reward.apply.gse.json >/dev/null && godot --headless --path . --export-debug "CODA Runtime macOS" /tmp/CODARuntime.app && "/tmp/CODARuntime.app/Contents/MacOS/CODA Runtime" --headless --quit
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run check && npm run test:godot && npm run export:pack
